event.text: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression at the base of the spine, which needs urgent MRI and specialist assessment today — delay risks permanent damage. Do not drive yourself if you feel weak or unsteady; call 911 if leg weakness, inability to urinate, or loss of bowel control develops.
